result: INCIDENT - device stopped at the loader guard after the kernel returned early

symptom.screen: ufs-read guard: ownership NOT returned; no HLOG/Android IO; manual fastboot required
symptom.log_content: loader banner, boot args and five clock lines only; no kernel init output
symptom.recovery: device entered fastboot; boot_a restored and verified byte-equal; Android 25s; SELinux Enforcing

what_was_wrong_before_the_flash: The mode-12 dispatch was missing from seven separate places; the first six were found by reading, the last by the host test.
Enumeration resumed in the leaf the lookup ended on, which belongs to the parent directory; it listed nothing.
The device was flashed before the host regression was run for this trial, which is the process error -- every earlier trial ran the full regression first.

state_of_the_work.mode_12_evidence: the driver lists the three entries and reports the directory's own leaf (13055) in the frozen-sample harness

unknown: Why the kernel produced only 609 bytes of log. The same image boots normally when the listing branch is compiled out, and the host harness exercises the branch without fault, so the difference is somewhere the harness cannot reach. Not diagnosed; the branch is not being taken to the device again until it is.
decision: Mode 12 stays as a host-verified capability. Stage 4's real subject -- a read-only mount reachable through ordinary paths -- does not depend on listing, and listing can ride along with it once the mount exists.
